events.name: HackWithAditya 2026
events.what: Submit a working prototype (Level 1) as a team of 4–6 college students; shortlisted teams build at the finale.
events.desc: Online hackathon open to currently-enrolled Indian college/university students. Prototype screening, then a 3-day build.

events.name: KIIT 4th Hackathon 2027 (ICDCIT)
events.what: Submit a project proposal on rural-India challenges; shortlisted teams build on campus.
events.desc: National hackathon alongside the ICDCIT conference at KIIT. Proposal screening then finals.

events.name: Hoya Hacks 2027 — Georgetown
events.what: Apply and build at Georgetown's collegiate hackathon (listed on Devpost).
events.desc: College-focused US university hackathon, open to student hackers worldwide.

deadlines.txt: Applications via Devpost — check the event page

events.name: James Dyson Award 2027
events.what: Submit an engineering/design invention that solves a problem (students + grads within 4 years).
events.desc: The premier student design-engineering prize — free, global, with national + international cash awards. 2026 closed 15 Jul; 2027 opens ~March.

events.name: Junction 2027 — Europe's largest hackathon
events.what: Apply as a team to Europe's largest hackathon; travel grants for some teams.
events.desc: ~2,000 hackers, broad tracks (AI, web, hardware). Open internationally; registration usually ~September.

events.name: Huawei ICT Competition 2026-27
events.what: University students compete in ICT tracks (network, cloud, computing, AI) across national → regional → global rounds.
events.desc: A huge global student ICT contest. Dates & registration vary by country/region; national rounds Nov–Dec 2026, regional ~Mar 2027.

events.name: Kaggle — ML & Data-Science Competitions
events.what: Enter ML/data-science competitions; the Getting Started track is beginner-friendly for students.
events.desc: The largest data-science competition platform — featured comps with cash + learning comps. Free to enter.

events.name: Zindi — Data-Science Challenges & University Hackathons
events.what: Enter real-world data-science/ML challenges, including student & inter-university events.
events.desc: Data-science competitions on real problems with cash/points; student-friendly difficulty labels. Good AI/ML practice.

events.name: MHacks 2027 — University of Michigan
events.what: Apply to Michigan's flagship hackathon (over $40K in prizes).
events.desc: A major US collegiate hackathon, open to students worldwide; applications ~Aug–Sep.

events.name: HackIllinois 2027 — UIUC
events.what: Apply to the open-source-focused hackathon at UIUC.
events.desc: A unique open-source hackathon; open to students, applications ~Dec–Jan.

events.name: Myntra WeForShe HackerRamp 2027
events.what: Women-in-tech hackathon for engineering students; pre-placement-interview chances with Myntra.
events.desc: National women-only engineering-student hackathon (prizes ~₹5 lakh, PPIs). Next cycle expected ~mid-2027.

events.name: Qualcomm Snapdragon / Edge-AI Developer Hackathons
events.what: Build real-world on-device / edge-AI solutions using Snapdragon across the hackathon series.
events.desc: Snapdragon Multiverse / Edge-AI Developer Hackathons — city editions across India; edge AI, multi-device. Strong EE/embedded + AI.

deadlines.txt: City editions announced through the year

events.name: Vishwakarma Awards — Hardware Innovation Challenge
events.what: Build a HARDWARE innovation to a theme over ~6 months; finale bootcamp at an IIT.
events.desc: National hardware innovation challenge for STEM students (3,600+ last cycle). Mechanical/electrical/robotics friendly. Current 2026-27 cycle runs to Feb 2027; next ~Aug 2027.

events.name: SAE Aero Design 2027 (East & West)
events.what: Design, build & fly a cargo-carrying radio-controlled aircraft as a university team.
events.desc: The classic collegiate aircraft design-build-fly series (East & West). Design report + flight rounds; international teams, incl. India, compete.

deadlines.txt: Season RFP ~mid-2026; events early-spring 2027 — register via sae.org

events.name: Meta Hacker Cup 2027
events.what: Solve algorithmic problems in timed online rounds; top coders win cash and reach the finals.
events.desc: Meta's open global competitive-programming contest — qualification + online rounds, cash prizes. Open to students worldwide.

events.name: ASME E-Fests Student Design Competitions 2027
events.what: Enter the Student Design Competition, Human-Powered Vehicle, or IAM3D build challenges at an ASME E-Fest.
events.desc: ASME's mechanical-engineering student design-build competitions (SDC, HPVC, IAM3D). International student chapters compete.

deadlines.txt: EFx events posted as confirmed — efests.asme.org

events.name: European Hyperloop Week 2027
events.what: Design, build & demonstrate a Hyperloop pod or subsystem as a university team.
events.desc: The main global student Hyperloop competition since SpaceX's ended — pod design, propulsion, levitation, vacuum & controls. International teams.

events.name: ADIPEC 2027 — Young ADIPEC & University Connect
events.org: dmg events / ADNOC · SPE technical conf.
events.what: Present research in University Connect / Innovation Zone and enter the student technical-paper track; Young ADIPEC.
events.desc: World's largest energy event — Maritime & Logistics Zone, Young ADIPEC (1,600+ students), University Connect showcase, SPE technical papers, internships into ADNOC/Baker Hughes. The key strategic GCC event. Official: 'November 2027, Abu Dhabi'; exact days to confirm.
events.fee: Young ADIPEC & student passes FREE (early reg)

events.name: Seatrade Maritime UAE 2027 (UAE Maritime Week)
events.what: Attend & network at MENA's flagship maritime event — talent sessions, company booths; bring a CV.
events.desc: UAE Maritime Week's flagship exhibition + conference — DP World, AD Ports, class societies, shipowners. The best face-to-face GCC maritime networking.

events.name: Breakbulk Middle East 2027
events.what: Attend the Middle East project-cargo, heavy-lift & offshore-logistics show.
events.desc: EPCI, marine heavy transport & offshore project logistics for the region — relevant for offshore-project / marine-contracting career paths.

events.name: Offshore Jack Up Middle East (OJME) 2027
events.what: Attend the Gulf's offshore jack-up rig conference — rig design, operations, integrity.
events.desc: Focused conference on jack-up rigs & offshore drilling units in the Middle East (2026 was ~Oct, Dubai). Networking with offshore operators/contractors; naval-architecture & offshore-structures relevant.

events.name: SPE GOTECH 2027 — University Student Experience + Paper Contest
events.what: Join the SPE Student Experience and enter the Middle East Student Paper Contest.
events.desc: Gas & Oil Technology Showcase — selected students attend alongside industry; the Middle East Student Paper Contest is hosted here. Offshore/marine papers eligible.

events.name: World Future Energy Summit 2027 (Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week)
events.what: Join the youth programme; offshore wind, marine & blue-energy tracks.
events.desc: Premier GCC clean-energy summit during Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week — offshore renewables, marine energy, hydrogen. Free youth programme for students.

events.name: Offshore Arabia 2027
events.what: Attend / present at the offshore oil, gas & marine-technology conference.
events.desc: Long-running Dubai offshore technology conference & exhibition — offshore engineering, subsea, marine structures. 2027 edition not yet confirmed; watch the site.

deadlines.txt: 2027 dates not yet confirmed — verify on site

events.name: The Maritime Standard Awards 2027
events.what: Attend the region's maritime awards gala — major GCC industry networking.
events.desc: The Gulf maritime industry's flagship awards night (shipowners, ports, class societies). Networking rather than a student competition, but a who's-who of GCC maritime.

events.name: MASTECH — Int'l Marine Technical Conference (MAST)
events.what: Present / attend a Gulf marine-technology conference run by naval-architecture alumni.
events.desc: Periodic marine-technical conference (editions 2013, 2019…) by MAST, the CUSAT naval-architecture alumni network in the UAE — strong Indian-NA diaspora networking. No 2027 edition announced yet.

deadlines.txt: No 2027 edition confirmed — watch MAST UAE channels

events.name: OTC 2027 — Offshore Technology Conference
events.what: Submit an abstract / present a paper — open to all (not student-only). World's largest offshore-energy conference.
events.desc: Deepwater, subsea, offshore wind, marine structures & pipelines. Full technical paper program; ADNOC/Aramco/NPCC all attend. Abstracts typically close ~Oct the year before.

events.name: IPTC 2027 — International Petroleum Technology Conference
events.what: Present a paper — open to all; major offshore/petroleum technical conference, often hosted in the GCC.
events.desc: Offshore, subsea, energy-transition & marine technical sessions; strong Gulf/Asia host rotation (Dhahran, Doha, Bangkok…). Full call for papers.

events.name: SPE ATCE 2027 — Annual Technical Conference & Exhibition
events.what: Submit a paper to SPE's flagship technical conference — open to all.
events.desc: The premier petroleum-engineering paper venue, with offshore/marine & energy-transition tracks. Students and professionals both present.

events.name: ASME IMECE 2027 — Int'l Mechanical Engineering Congress & Expo
events.what: Present a paper in any mechanical-engineering track — huge open call for papers.
events.desc: Thousands of papers across fluids, dynamics, materials, ocean/offshore, energy, robotics. One of the largest general mechanical-engineering CFP congresses; open to all.

events.name: ICCE 2028 — Int'l Conference on Coastal Engineering
events.what: Present a peer-reviewed paper on coastal & ocean engineering — open to all.
events.desc: Waves, sediment transport, coastal structures, ports & harbours. Biennial; proceedings widely cited. The flagship coastal-engineering CFP.

events.name: IMAM 2027 — Maritime Association of the Mediterranean Congress
events.what: Present a peer-reviewed paper — ship design, structures, hydrodynamics; open to all.
events.desc: International Maritime Association of the Mediterranean congress — naval architecture & marine engineering, strong European academic + industry mix.

events.name: ISSC — Int'l Ship & Offshore Structures Congress
events.what: Contribute to / present at the world authority congress on ship & offshore structures.
events.desc: ISSC committee reports + technical discussion — the top forum for ship & offshore structural research (fatigue, ultimate strength, loads, reliability).

events.name: WMTC — World Maritime Technology Conference
events.what: Present a paper at the umbrella congress of the world's maritime-technology societies.
events.desc: WMTC brings together RINA, SNAME, IMarEST and peer societies — the broadest naval-architecture / marine-engineering CFP. Prestigious global audience.

deadlines.txt: Next WMTC + CFP — via RINA / SNAME
